messages.subject: prodplot and legends
parts:
This does what I want

    Titanic %>% data.frame %>%
       prodplot(Freq ~ Survived + Class) + aes(fill=Survived,linetype=Survived) +
       scale_linetype_manual(values=rep("blank",2)) +
       scale_fill_manual(values=c("red3","green4"))

But reversing the order of the elements on the legend does not work

    Titanic %>% data.frame %>%
       prodplot(Freq ~ Survived + Class) + aes(fill=Survived,linetype=Survived) +
       scale_linetype_manual(values=rep("blank",2)) +
       scale_fill_manual(values=c("red3","green4"),guide=guide_legend(reverse=TRUE))

How can I just reverse the order of the legend items in the first chart
